title: Finite representatives realize section values
statement: Let A be an N-graded commutative ring, f homogeneous of positive degree b, k an integer, and s a section of twist k on D₊(f). Write B=A_(f) and M=A_f. There are n, g:Fin n→B spanning the unit ideal, and t_i in M localized at g_i, such that for every p in D₊(f) and every additive e:M_(g_i)→A_p extending the canonical map M→A_p and compatible with the B-action through A_p, e(t_i)=s(p).

source.place: Lemma 27.8.4 and its preceding construction, specialized to the shift A(k); this split separates ordinary gluing from degree detection

proof.text: The locally homogeneous-fraction predicate for the twist gives a/d on a neighborhood. Refine by D₊(u), then replace by N/h=(a*u*f)/(d*u*f) so h has positive degree c. The chart sends this to D(h^b/f^c); quasi-compactness extracts a finite cover and the chart elements span one. Construct t=(h^(b-1)*N/f^c)/(h^b/f^c). For any e with the two identities, applying e to g*(1/g)=1 forces F(g) to be a unit and hence p to lie in D₊(h). Applying e to g*t=z gives the asserted value after cancellation. On the empty chart take the empty family in the zero ring.

proof_origin.place: Section 27.8; Lemma 27.8.1 and preceding construction; G3 second reading supplies the explicit localization argument.

theorem twist_finiteLocal_values
    {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (k : ℤ) (f : A) (b : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 b)
    (s : (twist 𝒜 k).val.obj (op (basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    let B := HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f
    let M := LocalizedModule.Away f A
    letI : Module B M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f))
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → B) (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
      (t : ∀ i : Fin n, LocalizedModule.Away (g i) M),
      ∀ (i : Fin n) (p : basicOpen 𝒜 f)
        (e : LocalizedModule.Away (g i) M →+
          Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal),
        (∀ z : M, e (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (g i)) M z) =
          IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
            (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
            (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
            (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2) z) →
        (∀ (a : B) (x : LocalizedModule.Away (g i) M),
          e (a • x) =
            IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
              (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
              (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
              (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2)
              (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) a) * e x) →
        e (t i) = (s.1 p).1
